title: Is Bitcoin Really Anonymous? The Myth That Surprises Beginners
caption: Educational only. Not financial advice. Bitcoin is usually pseudonymous, not anonymous: the ledger is public and addresses can sometimes be linked to people. Sources: Nasdaq, River. AI-generated voice. Which crypto myth should we bust next? Educational only. Not financial advice.

scenes.head: MYTH
scenes.narration: Bitcoin is not anonymous. Here is the myth most beginners believe.

scenes.head: THE FACT
scenes.narration: Every Bitcoin transaction is recorded on a public ledger that anyone can read, and it never gets erased.

scenes.head: THE CATCH
scenes.hook: ADDRESSES CAN BE LINKED TO YOU
scenes.narration: Your address is a code, not a name. But when you use an exchange or share it, it can be linked to you.

scenes.head: WHAT TO DO
scenes.hook: TREAT IT AS PUBLIC, NOT SECRET
scenes.narration: Think pseudonymous, not invisible. Be careful what you share about your wallet.
